Callout.Name: Disorder at a Hospital
Callout.Message: Person abusing staff in an emergency department.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, no weapon, staff want them removed.

Script.Line: I have been waiting four hours and nobody has told me anything.
My father is in there and they will not let me see him.
I have not threatened anybody. Ask the staff.

Lines.Approach: They are shouting at people who are trying to work. No weapon, but it is an emergency department.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
